note: NECO Civic round 6 (R36 top-up): limited government; the constitution's supremacy; deportation of undesirable aliens; the naira's two signatures; driving against traffic; monogamy; gender equality; courage; self-reliance; transparency; election observers; impeachment; the police; NSCDC; fire service; colonialism; ethnicism; disability discrimination; UBE; arbitration; freedom of association; made-in-Nigeria goods; fake news; hate speech; examination malpractice. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-5, WAEC Civic (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
